description.en: The first of the Big Three to arrive at your lawn, leading an army of kongfu zombies.
description.zh: 最先到访你的前院的武林巨头，引领着所有武斗僵尸。

chat.en: As the third-in-command of the Big Three, Devil of Dynamite excels in diplomacy. Dr.Zomboss took advantage of this, forging an alliance with all the zombies at Kongfu Temple, and even developing a new method to open a space-time portal.
chat.zh: 作为武林三巨头的三把手，火药魔头最擅长外交。僵尸博士利用这一点与少林寺的所有僵尸达成共识，甚至研究出打开时空大门的新方法。

text.en: lobbed bombs destroy plants in a 3x3 area if their targets are not shoveled in time
text.zh: 如果没能及时铲除目标，丢出的炸弹将摧毁 3x3 范围内的植物

text.en: summon Rocket Imps, both launched from the right and lobbed from his back
text.zh: 从背后丢出或从场外召唤出火箭小鬼
